newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk cement merger shares to be listed on Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: Turk cement merger shares to be listed on Oct 1.

text.p: Shares of Turkish cement merger Akcansa A.S. will be listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange's national market on October 1, the Exchange said.
Two leading cement producers Canakkale Cimento of Belgian Cimenteries CBR SA and Akcimento of Turkish Sabanci conglomerate recently merged to set up Turkey's biggest cement group.

The opening price of Akcansa will be based on the total market capitalisation of Akcimento and Canakkale Cimento at their last weighted average prices, to be divided by 3,805,157,318 shares representing Akcansa's capital.
Existing Akcimento shareholders are to receive shares making up 48.45 percent of Akcansa's 3.805-trillion-lira capital and Canakkale shareholders will get 51.55 percent.
The Exchange said existing Akcimento and Canakkale shares were expected to be replaced by newly printed Akcansa shares from September 30 when Akcansa's title will become official.
The new Akcansa shares must also be registered by the regulatory Capital Market Board (SPK) before being allowed to trade on the bourse.

Trading in Akcimento and Canakkale Cimento shares will simultaneously stop on October 1 and Akcimento will be excluded from the Exchange listing while Canakkale will be replaced by Akcansa, the Exchange said.
Canakkale shares last traded at 8,000 lira and Akcimento at 6,300 lira. -- Aydan Eksin, Istanbul newsroom 490-212-275 0875
